title: Probability: equally likely and independent events

questions.prompt: A fair coin is tossed twice. What is the probability of getting heads both times?

misconception.label: Consider only one toss
misconception.explanation: Both tosses must be heads, so multiply 1/2 by 1/2.

misconception.label: Treat HH, HT and TT as equally likely
misconception.explanation: HT and TH are separate outcomes; the four ordered results are equally likely.

questions.prompt: A fair six-sided die is rolled. What is the probability of rolling a number greater than 4?

misconception.label: Count 4 as a successful outcome
misconception.explanation: Only 5 and 6 are greater than 4; 4 itself is not.

misconception.label: Count only five possible die results
misconception.explanation: A six-sided die has six equally likely results, including 4.

questions.prompt: A bag has 2 red and 3 blue marbles. You draw one red marble and keep it out. What is the probability the next marble is red?

misconception.label: Assume the first marble was replaced
misconception.explanation: After removing one red marble, only one red remains among four marbles.

misconception.label: Keep the original total after removing a marble
misconception.explanation: The bag now has four marbles, not five.

questions.prompt: A fair coin has landed heads four times in a row. What is the probability of heads on the next toss?

misconception.label: Past heads make heads less likely
misconception.explanation: The fair coin does not remember previous tosses.

misconception.label: A streak makes heads more likely
misconception.explanation: Each independent toss of a fair coin still has two equally likely results.

questions.prompt: A fair spinner has 4 equal-sized sections: 1 red and 3 blue. What is the probability it lands on red?

misconception.label: Two colors must be equally likely
misconception.explanation: The colors cover different numbers of equal-sized sections.

misconception.label: Count the blue sections as red
misconception.explanation: Only one of the four equal-sized sections is red.
